### Independent Bank Corp. Announces Schedule of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/952898466/files/doc_news/Independent-Bank-Corp--Announces-Schedule-of-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


ROCKLAND, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Independent Bank Corp. (Nasdaq Global Select Market: INDB), parent of Rockland Trust Company, announced the following details for its third quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call:


**Earnings Release** : Thursday, October 15, 2026, after the market close


**Conference Call (held via Webcast):** Friday, October 16, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Time


**How to Join Webcast:** Participants may join the webcast by registering prior to the call via this link:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/687573325](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F687573325__%3B%21%21DUHle9IWsHMULw%21alSusW0r7hXN4FxEnKboXcKUUlxq3Sd-92FsqNBETY4k3aSCbtnlq6N-cLkie0pN2Sg_2zUfYmABJKWeSGABJjr50nSWL74kwg%24&esheet=54616183&newsitemid=20261005770704&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F687573325&index=1&md5=904cc6bd5be044b0c527c47e9c40e1d3)


A replay of the webcast will be made available on the Company’s website at[https://indb.rocklandtrust.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Findb.rocklandtrust.com&esheet=54616183&newsitemid=20261005770704&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Findb.rocklandtrust.com&index=2&md5=0cf7245fe4382e939c8306f16cc3067a) by selecting Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call. The webcast replay will be available until October 16, 2027.


Independent Bank Corp. (NASDAQ Global Select Market: INDB) is the holding company for Rockland Trust Company, a full-service commercial bank headquartered in Massachusetts. With retail branches in Eastern Massachusetts, Worcester County, and Southern New Hampshire as well as commercial banking and investment management offices in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island, Rockland Trust offers a wide range of banking, investment, and insurance services to individuals, families, and businesses. Rockland Trust also offers a full suite of mobile, online, and telephone banking services. Rockland Trust is an FDIC member and an Equal Housing Lender.
